name: scroll-area
title: Scroll area
description: A scrolling region whose edges fade where content continues.
use: A region that scrolls inside the page: a long list in a panel, a wide table, a log. Give it a height or a maximum height, and tabindex="0", a role and a label unless it holds focusable content.

instead.when: The row of items snaps from one slide to the next
Two regions share the space and each scrolls by itself

keyboard.keys: ArrowUp, ArrowDown, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
keyboard.action: Scroll the focused region, as the browser does

platform.fallback: The region scrolls the same and its edges stay clean, with no fade

classes.name: scroll-area
classes.description: A region that scrolls along the block axis, with a thin scrollbar and edges that fade where content continues

classes.name: scroll-area-inline
classes.description: Scrolls along the inline axis and fades the start and end edges

properties.name: --scroll-area-fade
properties.description: Length of the fade at each edge

example:
2.1 adds overlays that need no script.

Dialogs open with invoker commands and trap focus on their own.

Popovers, menus and tooltips are placed with anchor positioning and flip at the viewport edge.
